intent.en: Formally replace the task with incomplete delivery claims; migrate only resident_mixed_validate while freezing CUDA and synchronous order, then complete typed gates, verification evidence and delivery receipt.

acceptance: 仅修改resident.rs、任务证据与交付回执。

记录原始输出、归档映射、GPU整卡样本和历史PTX对照。
目标测试、格式、静态检查与Normify校验通过。
提交回执绑定暂存对象并完成提交后收尾。
